'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Matthew Ulstad DS Starter Dark Side Deck''' is the Dark Side decklist sheet turned in by [[Matthew Ulstad]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).

The sheet is a handwritten note that reads ''Starter Dark Side Deck'', followed by ''(But seriously) It was'', and lists no cards. Which starter deck it was is not stated.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' unknown (sheet reads ''Starter Dark Side Deck'')
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

== Decklist ==

''Not listed: the sheet names no cards.''
